concept: S3 Gateway VPC endpoint: bypass NAT Gateway for S3 traffic
tests: Reducing NAT Gateway data processing charges when private instances access S3.
expected: Create an S3 Gateway VPC endpoint (free) and route S3 traffic through it — NAT is not involved, instances stay private. Triggers: "private subnets", "large volumes from S3", "high NAT Gateway data processing charges".
why_not: A NAT instance still passes the traffic and adds administration; public subnets violate the privacy requirement; Transfer Acceleration speeds up uploads for an extra fee and does not bypass NAT.
